crossRefs.note: Thus they were divided impartially by drawing lots; for there were princes of the sanctuary, and princes of God, both…
Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the scribe, who was of the Levites, wrote them in the presence of the king, the princes…
According to the lot shall their inheritance be divided between the more and the fewer.”
They cast lots for their offices, all alike, the small as well as the great, the teacher as well as the student.
They cast lots, the small as well as the great, according to their fathers’ houses, for every gate.

people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Ahimelech
people.line: Son of Abiathar, a priest during David's reign

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

people.name: Zadok
people.line: High priest during the reigns of David and Solomon

translations.web: These likewise cast lots even as their brothers the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites; the fathers’ households of the chief even as those of his younger brother.
translations.bsb: As their brothers the descendants of Aaron did, they also cast lots in the presence of King David and of Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the families of the priests and Levites—the family heads and their younger brothers alike.
translations.kjv: These likewise cast lots over against their brethren the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites, even the principal fathers over against their younger brethren.
translations.asv: These likewise cast lots even as their brethren the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the heads of the fathers' houses of the priests and of the Levites; the fathers' houses of the chief even as those of his younger brother.
